⁠
Hudson is excited to be partnering with a Sydney-based tech focused organisation to hire for an Associate level Software Engineer.
We are seeking a talented and driven Software Engineer to work in a highly collaborative Agile environment. You'll contribute to the design, development, security, and scalability of cutting-edge products. This role offers an opportunity to work on large-scale enterprise applications, enhancing your technical skills and you will be part of a mission critical application.
Key Responsibilities:
● Deliver scalable, high-performance solutions as part of an Agile team
● Collaborate across teams to ensure seamless integration between multiple projects
● Develop and implement software designs and requirements, ensuring code quality and adherence to coding standards
● Fully document software features and functionality
● Participate in planning, backlog grooming, and technical design discussions across multiple projects
● Break down larger project stories into smaller tasks and estimate effort for backlog items
● Continuously seek learning opportunities to improve your knowledge
● Conduct presentations and provide training to support talent development within the organization
● Perform code reviews and ensure high standards of development quality
Qualifications & Experience:
● 1-3 years of relevant commercial programming experience in
Java and/or React
● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with attention to detail
● Strong collaboration and communication skills across teams and time zones
● Experience working in highly collaborative environments and delivering world-class products
● Proven experience delivering software on a global scale, from new products to incremental updates
● Meticulous attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills
● Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management abilities
● Strong verbal and written communication skills
Should you be interested, kindly furnish your application to
isabelle.ho2@hudson.com
with an updated resume and contact number. Do note at point of application we will only be able to consider candidates who are Australia Citizen/PR due to the sensitivty of the project and are currently based in Sydney, NSW.
